messages:
maya: quick heads-up  launching a 2-week trial called PeerShelf for micro recognition. goal: low-friction nominations, small desk token + handwritten note. need owners for: vendor coord, shipping, comms, and note-writing volunteers. target ship date: 2024-04-15.

samir: I can run vendor & shipping. please freeze headcount by 4/08. approx budget? :dollar:

kelly: approved budget cap $8/kit + shipping, up to 500 recipients. i'll own PO and cost tracking.

jonathan: volunteer to draft Slack/email copy + short nomination form (one-liner noms). prefer casual tone.

maya: thanks. @samir confirm if our usual pin vendor can do enamel pin + postcard within timeline.

samir: pinged vendor, lead time ~10 business days. getting quote now.

peopleops-bot: Inventory report: pins=120, postcards=300, blank cards=200.

kelly: remote folks get equivalent shipped boxes; finance will handle customs if value > $50. flag any non-standard countries.

tia: I can coordinate handwritten notes and run a volunteer sign-up for note writers.

maya: perfect. tia please schedule note-writing sessions the week prior to shipping. i'll collect packages at HQ 4/12-4/14.

jonathan: draft announcement (will be brief):
```
Hey all  PeerShelf micro-recognition is live. Nominate a teammate with one sentence describing why. Winners get a small desk token + handwritten note. Nominations close 4/10. Submit: <form-link>
```

maya: add anonymous option + note that winners will be contacted before public shoutouts.

samir: quote received: $6.50/kit + ~$3 domestic shipping. uploaded to shared drive `vendor-quotes/peershelf-q1.pdf`. vendor needs final sticker art by 4/03.

jonathan: will ask design for a sticker mock today.

kelly: ops metrics to track: nomination count, team distribution, on-time shipments. add to Postmortem checklist.

samir: logistics checklist I'm tracking:
- finalize qty 4/08
- vendor delivery 4/10
- pack 4/12-4/14
- ship HQ desks 4/15
- remote ship by 4/16
I'll attach this to the shared sheet.

tia: volunteer sign-up created: <signup-link>. two note-writing sessions scheduled 4/12 PM and 4/13 AM.

maya: opt-out option? add to form for people who do not want packages.

jonathan: FAQ item: "How are winners chosen?" -> peer nominations reviewed by ops; aim to represent diverse teams.

kelly: I'll get PO number by 4/06.

samir: vendor needs final art and qty by 4/03 to meet lead time.

jonathan: planning to post announcement 4/11 10:00 PT in #general unless objection.

tia: excited, no objections! :party_parrot: 

peopleops-bot: Reminder scheduled: collect final headcount on 2024-04-08 09:00 UTC.
